Hi Jonas —

Quick heads up: Anil (our Head of AI Ops) has had his travel extended unexpectedly and won’t be back until Friday, June 4. He’s the main decision-maker for tooling and will need to see the demo live if possible.

Given that, we have two options that would work internally:
1) Move the on-site to the following week (Mon, June 7 or Tue, June 8) so Anil can attend live in-person.
2) Proceed on June 1 with an asynchronous recording of the tailored demo for the team, plus a 30-minute live office-hours session (video) on Tue, June 1 afternoon so Anil can join remotely if he’s available, or we can do a follow-up with him the week of June 7.

We’re leaning toward option 2 because we also have a field event on June 2 that tightens our on-site schedule, and the rest of the stakeholders will be available on June 1.

Can you confirm whether you’d be able to prepare a short recorded demo and host a 30-minute live Q&A the same afternoon? Also — any materials we should circulate to attendees ahead of the recording?

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Product Programs | MedTech Inc
maya.patel@medtechinc.com | +1 617-555-4820

- Model routing and warm KV cache behavior for imaging workloads

- Schedule a 30-minute Zoom office hours slot on Tue, June 1 at 1:00 PM ET (10:00 AM PT) for live Q&A.
